title: [AI][BACKEND] Simulated portfolio API
summary: Simulated portfolio with seeded cash, holdings, buy/sell at quote price, and transaction history — not real trading.
problems_solved: No way to demo portfolio tracking without brokerage integration
Buy/sell validation missing — could overspend cash or sell more than held
Holdings PnL not computed — UI would need duplicate finance logic

decisions: Seed cash_balance 100000 USD on first GET /portfolio
Execution price from market_data.get_quote at submit time
422 UNPROCESSABLE for insufficient cash or quantity

context_for_future: GET /api/v1/portfolio/summary convenience endpoint still optional for dashboard
Frontend portfolio page uses POST transactions then refreshes holdings
Quote source at execution stored on transaction for audit trail
